# TDPdf v2.2.1.0

**Safer with files from strangers, a Remove crop button, and a big internal cleanup.**

## Security

- A specially made PDF can no longer crash TDPdf or freeze its window. Before, one file could close every open tab and lose unsaved work.
- Copies TDPdf makes while you work (decrypted copies of password-protected files, and copies from before a redaction) are now deleted when you close the tab or TDPdf. Before, they stayed in your temp folder.
- Saving a password-protected PDF asks first if the save would weaken or remove its password protection.
- Very large compressed content and oversized zip files are refused instead of filling memory or disk.
- OCR language downloads are checked before they are used.
- Fixes for administrators: Intune installs only write to a folder that administrators own, and only an administrator can switch telemetry off for the whole machine.

## Crop

- The crop tool has a **Remove crop** button. It works on the current page, or on every page when **Apply to all pages** is ticked, and you can undo it.

## Fixes

- Pages rotated 90 or 270 degrees are the right shape in continuous view, and Fit Page zooms correctly there.
- Selection and focus colours match the Light and High Contrast themes.
- Open and Save dialogs always appear in front of TDPdf.
- Cancelling **Make Searchable PDF** no longer leaves a partial file.

## Under the hood

- Updated PDF rendering (PDFium 159), text extraction and font libraries.
- A large cleanup of the code with no change in behaviour, and about 230 new automated checks, including one for each of the security fixes above.
